learning_outcomes.text: Knows the concepts of ethics and professional ethics
Comprehends and evaluates responsibility and professional responsibility
Gains the ability to evaluate professional risks

syllabus_topics: Introduction to ethics, course objective, outcomes
What is ethics?, Definition and historical development
The origin and purpose of ethics
Types of ethics. Metaethics Normative ethics (Teleological ethics)
Normative ethics (Deontological ethics) and Applied ethics
Concepts of norm, value, and law
Ethical dilemmas and solution approaches, Examples
Factors affecting ethical or unethical actions
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of our University Senate.
